lines.trans: Pardon the intrusion. This is a police raid.
We are arresting Toshi Arai on suspicion of drug use and producing underground videos.
Japan's industry king arrested—tomorrow's newspaper headlines will be filled with this.
Once a man who built an era gets swept along by the times, he is finished, right?
So that is how it goes.
Listen though, Muranishi, don't get the wrong idea.
If you ever touch underground tapes yourself, I will come arrest you personally.
Keep yourself ready for that.
Do you want to arrest me next?

words.gram: Past た-form of する (to do/happen).

lines.trans: For now, you are a necessary piece for keeping order on the streets.
Because cops like us and guys like you are two sides of the same coin.

meanings.note: All-purpose action verb; turns Sino-Japanese nouns into verbs (融通する, 出店する) and with に means 'decide on' or 'make into'.
Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.

examples.text: まだ俺眠いんだよ。はい、摘発。
examples.trans: I'm still sleepy here. Alright, this is a bust.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.
Written を and pronounced o; marks what an action directly acts upon.

examples.text: 荒井トシを薬物使用の容疑と裏ビデオの制作で逮捕する。
examples.trans: We are arresting Toshi Arai on suspicion of drug use and producing underground videos.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).

examples.text: ビザ詐欺の容疑で逮捕しておいて、古い法律で起訴してるんですよ。
examples.trans: They arrested him on visa fraud suspicions, then indicted him under an archaic law.

meanings.note: Opposite of 表 (public surface); 裏の世界 means 'the underworld / hidden world'.

examples.trans: Shall I show you the hidden world?

examples.trans: It is one thousand yen in total.

examples.text: 時代が変わりましたね。

meanings.en: come; go do something and return (after て-form)
meanings.note: Written in kana after a て-form (話してきます), expresses stepping away to do an action and coming back.

examples.text: ちょっと水を買ってきます。
examples.trans: I will go buy some water and be right back.

meanings.note: Marks the subject of existence, emergence, or questions (どれが), and at the end of a polite clause softens a request (のですが).

examples.text: お願いがあるのですが。
examples.trans: I have a favor to ask.

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.

examples.text: 時代を作ってきた男が時代に流されたら終わりだろ？
examples.trans: Once a man who built an era gets swept along by the times, he is finished, right?

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Noun derived from 終わる (to end).

examples.text: これで今日の授業は終わりです。
examples.trans: With this, today's class is over.

meanings.note: Refers to facts, matters, or affairs rather than physical objects (もの).

examples.text: 仕事のことを話します。

meanings.note: Turns a statement into a question, or softens a volitional/negative guess.
Limits the preceding noun or phrase to that item alone.

examples.text: これだけお願いします。

meanings.en: casual reflection or firm reminder particle
meanings.note: Used aloud to oneself ('man, I'm hungry') or at the end of a warning ('remember that, okay?').
Reflexive pronoun pointing back to the person under discussion.

examples.text: 自分の言葉で話します。
examples.trans: I speak in my own words.

meanings.en: open a store; bring out; hand in
meanings.note: 店を出す means opening a branch; 出しやがって attaches tough-guy disdainful やがる.

examples.text: 駅前に新しい店を出します。
examples.trans: We open a new branch in front of the station.

examples.text: 書類を出してください。

meanings.note: Attaches to a past-stem verb form to set up a condition ('if a fire starts').

examples.text: 火事になったら大変です。
examples.trans: If a fire breaks out, it will be terrible.

examples.text: 家に帰ったら電話します。
examples.trans: I will call when I get home.

meanings.note: Used among friends and peers by men; switch to 私 or 僕 in formal settings.

おく.gloss: do in advance; keep in state

meanings.note: After a te-form (積んでおきました, contracted 入っとけ), indicates doing something in advance or staying put.

examples.trans: I will leave it here for now.

meanings.note: Marks the presence of a person (責任者はいるか) or follows て-form (often contracted to てる/てます in speech).

りんごを一つください。

meanings.note: Can stand at the head of a sentence without a particle ('right now').
Polite/dialectal negative ending, especially in ～ません.
Plural of 俺 (おれ) with pluralizing suffix ら.

できる.gloss: be built; open; be able to

meanings.en: come into existence; be completed; can do
meanings.note: With buildings or stores (店ができる), means a new shop has been built or opened.

examples.text: 駅前に新しいカフェができました。
examples.trans: A new café opened in front of the station.

examples.text: 日本語が少しできます。
examples.trans: I can speak a little Japanese.

meanings.note: Contracts では; launches a decision ('well then') or opens casual farewell じゃあね.
Checks agreement ('isn't it?') or softens a request or farewell.
